usage: Used to describe plants, trees, grass, or crops that are growing very well and look full, healthy, and thick.
Often appears with nature and gardening nouns such as trees, flowers, grass, leaves, or a garden; it sounds natural in written and spoken Cantonese.
Can also describe hair or eyebrows when they look thick and healthy, but that is a more figurative use.
This word is descriptive rather than emotional; it usually gives a positive, vivid image of strong growth.
